notes: ENCODING: all 11 files are UTF-8 WITH BOM. None required GB18030/CP936. Decode with `utf-8-sig`. No mojibake found.

ALIGNMENT METHOD: no timestamp matching was needed — every one of the 4 usable .ssa files packs ZH and EN into a SINGLE Dialogue event separated by the literal `\N` (ZH first, EN second), e.g. `Dialogue: Marked=0,0:05:00.71,...,{\r中文}生命迹象指数全为绿色 看来她还活着{\r}\NBio readouts are all in the green.` Parser: strip `{...}` override tags, split on `\N`, classify each segment by presence of U+4E00–U+9FFF. This gives perfectly-aligned pairs with zero heuristic risk.
TOTAL DIALOGUE LINES MINED: 4,665 events / 4,601 with BOTH languages present. Per film: ALIEN1979 932 events (910 bilingual), ALIENS1986 1,417 (1,414), ALIEN3 1,414 (1,379), RESURRECTION 902 (898).

FILE REDUNDANCY: the `.srt` files and the reversed-order `.ssa` files carry NO text the primary bilingual `.ssa` does not. Only 4 files needed mining. If the user wants to prune the folder, the 4 canonical sources are the `chs&eng`/`简体&英文` SSAs plus the Alien 1979 RARBG SSA.

ALIEN 1979 FILE IS MISLABELED: its filename (`...RARBG.ssa`, no language tag) implies English-only, but it is a Chinese/English bilingual CnSCG (圣城家园, 南宫长风) release — same fansub group as the other three. All four films therefore come from ONE translation lineage, which explains most of the cross-film consistency AND means the corpus is NOT four independent votes.
BIGGEST FINDING — 异形 vs 异型: there is NO conflict. 异形 appears 56 times across all four films; 异型 appears ZERO times. Safe to fix 异形 as the project standard.

BIGGEST FINDING — Weyland-Yutani: the only rendering attested is 伟伦优达尼 (2 occurrences, Alien 3 + Resurrection). Neither 韦兰-尤坦尼 nor 维兰德-尤坦尼 (the forms named in the task) appears anywhere. 伟伦优达尼 is a Taiwan-flavoured phonetic and is NOT the mainland-common form; recommend treating this as WEAK evidence and resolving against wiki/community sources before adopting.

REAL CONFLICTS TO ARBITRATE (both sides reported above): Queen 女王(7, Aliens+A3) vs 王后(4, Resurrection); Ripley 蕾普丽(82, 3 films) vs 蕾普莉(12, Alien 1979 only); cryo-tube 低温舱(7, A3) vs 冰温舱(3, AR); synthetic 生化人/人造人/机械人/合成人 (four ways); Sergeant 士官长(4) vs 中士(1) within the same film; host 宿主(4) vs 寄主(2); Ash 艾希(13) vs 艾许(1); Brett 布雷特(8)/布瑞特(2)/布瑞(3); Hicks 希克斯(31) vs 西克斯(1); Hudson 哈德逊(34) vs 韩森(1).

THE SUBS ARE A WEAK SOURCE FOR RPG MECHANICS VOCABULARY. Terms with ZERO attestation in all four films: Facehugger, Chestburster, Ovomorph, Drone, Warrior, USCSS, USCM, Acheron, Hadley's Hope, Special Order 937 (the number), Executive Officer, MU/TH/UR (spelled), Narcissus, Anchorpoint, 'in space no one can hear you scream'. Terms present but BADLY rendered (do not adopt): APC→焚化炉/失事船, dropship→船, smart gun→机关枪, remote sentry→机械感应器, stasis→静态平衡, incinerator→焚化炉, seismic survey charges→爆炸损害, 'science division'→卫生署, Ellen→海伦.

STRONGEST HARVEST (adopt with confidence): 异形, 怪物, 公司, 生化人, 机器人, 人造人, 宿主, 寄生虫, 强酸, 标本, 长眠, 隔离/检疫, 喷火枪, 追踪器/行动追踪器, 救生船, 医疗室, 信号, 中尉/下士/船长, 主教, plus the whole Aliens 1986 character-name set (希克斯/哈德逊/娃丝佳/高曼/阿朋/垂克/法斯/弗洛/迪杰/纽特/巴克).

GRAMMAR NOTE FOR THE GLOSSARY: the subs make a clean ZH split that the English does not — 异形 = the creature (noun), 外星 = alien/extraterrestrial (adjective, as in 外星船 'alien ship'). Worth encoding as two glossary entries so the pipeline does not translate 'alien ship' as 异形船.

SHIP-NAME PATTERN: all vessel names take the 号 suffix — 诺斯都罗莫号, 苏拉可号, 贝蒂号, 奥瑞戈号. Ship prefixes (USCSS/U.S.M.) are always dropped in the ZH. Recommend the project standardise on `<音译>号` and decide separately how to carry prefixes.
THE ALIEN 3 SUBS USE 复仇161星 for 'Fury 161' — a semantic ('vengeance') rather than phonetic rendering, and it silently drops that Fury is a corruption of Fiorina. Flag for review.

SCRIPTS ARE REUSABLE: `python .../alien_subs/find.py '<regex>' [en|zh] [limit]` prints every aligned pair matching the pattern on the chosen side, prefixed with film + timestamp. Use it to check any additional term without re-parsing.
